business.title: Jensen Huang Bluntly States: Subscribing to APIs Can Never Remedy Mediocre Management
business.description: Treating modern data centers as high-efficiency oil refineries—where raw digital information is systematically processed, refined into actionable high-value assets, and distributed to power critical business operations—emphasizes that organizations must never outsource their core strategic decision-making capabilities to external third parties. This forward-thinking framework underscores the importance of retaining full in-house control over proprietary data governance, core operational intelligence, and critical business logic, preventing over-reliance on external vendors that could erode data sovereignty, introduce hidden operational risks, and dilute competitive advantages in today’s data-driven digital economy. By positioning data centers as the central "refinery" for transforming unstructured raw data into refined, business-critical resources while safeguarding independent, in-house strategic thinking, enterprises can build resilient, self-determined digital infrastructures that support long-term sustainable growth and uncompromised data security.

science.title: Ancient charcoal reveals evidence of wildfires near the South Pole
science.description: A journey back in time to the Late Cretaceous: A swampy rainforest with conifers and tree ferns stretches as far as the eye can see, dinosaurs roam through the misty wetlands, and the climate is mild and warm. There is plenty of water, too, as dry periods are regularly followed by monsoon-like rainy seasons.
